manifest top-level keys == heroine hsc19 manifest
character is member-only zhao-ling (no appearance key)
index has exactly the zhao-ling key, no hero key, names the manifest
eight canonical actions: required with loop flags + skill
contract fields == heroine (cell, pivot, facing, scale, proportion)
cell and pivot even (logical scale 0.5)
every action duration == heroine (ticks)
tick schema: every action tick_rate 30, frames use ticks only, loop_start only on loops
firing cue (muzzle flash) on attack frame 0 = tick 0; no other attack frame flashes
recoil after the shot: muzzle rises and the hand pulls back on attack-recoil
skill = Echo ranging (ping from antenna, sweep from tablet, lock reticle)
defeat ends kneeling with eyes shut
sheet is a cell multiple, 6 columns, each cell == its pose PNG; package copy == outputs copy
idle silhouette distinct from heroine idle (IoU < 0.85, not a recolour)
idle silhouette distinct from male mcombat22 idle (IoU < 0.85, not a recolour)
still package pixels == idle-a
all asset names <= 140 chars and in project/subject/purpose/variant/timestamp-id form
